newsitem.title: USA: Amgen Neupogen, Epogen sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Amgen Neupogen, Epogen sales rise.

text.p: Amgen Inc, which earlier reported higher third quarter earnings, said its Epogen sales rose 19 percent to $274 million during the period and Neupogen sales were up 12 percent to $259 million.
The company also said that research and development spending rose 24 percent during the quarter to $130 million. R&D spending accounted for 24 percent of third quarter sales.

It said several of its pipeline candidates reached "significant" development milestones during the quarter, and that the company reached its goal of starting Phase I trials of five potential products this year.

During the quarter, Amgen began a safety and tolerability study of GDNF, or Glial Cell Line-Derived Neurotrophic Factor for Parkinson's disease treatment, and filed an investigational new drug application to begin a safety study of GDNF as a treatment for Lou Gehrig's disease treatment.
It also said that early clinical trial results on the platelet stimulating factor MGDF, as a treatment for acute myeloid leukemia were not promising.
